name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes (PMS-SC)
description: Central scheme for SC students studying after Class 10. Income limit ₹2.5 lakh. No minimum marks for a fresh application.
benefits: Compulsory fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance, paid by DBT to your bank account.
source_organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribes (PMS-ST)
description: Central scheme for ST students studying after Class 10. Income limit ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Compulsory fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance, paid by DBT to your bank account.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students (PM YASASVI)
description: Central PM YASASVI sub-scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT students in Class 11 and above (diploma, degree, PG, PhD). Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Apply on NSP; your state welfare department verifies it.
benefits: Academic allowance of roughly ₹5,000–₹20,000 a year depending on course group, plus compulsory fee support (per scheme summaries — confirm on NSP).
source_organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: PM YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
steps_name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description: Merit-based scheme for OBC/EBC/DNT students admitted to a notified Top Class institution (list on NSP). Full-time courses only. Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Your college must be on the list.
benefits: Full tuition support up to about ₹2 lakh a year plus allowances (per NSP summaries — confirm the exact components on NSP).
source_organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
required_documents: Admission proof at a notified Top Class institution

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
steps_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
description: Merit-cum-means scheme of the Ministry of Education: above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in your Class 12 board stream, regular (not distance, not diploma) degree course, family income up to ₹4.5 lakh, no other scholarship or fee reimbursement. NOTE: NSP listings for 2026-27 show this scheme as open for RENEWAL only — fresh applicants must check NSP before applying.
benefits: ₹12,000 a year for graduation (first 3 years), ₹20,000 a year for post-graduation and for the 4th/5th year of professional courses.
source_organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities (Central)
description: Ministry of Minority Affairs scheme for Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Parsi students from Class 11 to PhD. At least 50% marks in the previous exam and family income up to ₹2 lakh. 30% of awards are for girls.
benefits: Admission + tuition fee and maintenance allowance, subject to maximum ceilings set in the scheme norms.
required_documents: Income certificate (issued by competent State/UT authority)
Minority community certificate (self-declaration if 18+, parent/guardian certified if minor)
Fee receipt of current course year

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minorities (Central)
description: Ministry of Minority Affairs scheme for minority students in professional and technical courses (UG and PG). At least 50% marks in the last qualifying exam and family income up to ₹2.5 lakh. 30% of awards are for girls. Check the exact 2026-27 last date on NSP.
benefits: Admission + course fee and maintenance allowance, subject to ceilings in the official guidelines.
required_documents: Income certificate (issued by competent State/UT authority)
Minority community certificate (self-declaration if 18+, parent/guardian certified if minor)
Fee receipt of current course year
Admission proof in a professional/technical course
